selections.comment: An extremely open race which could allow RUKAANA to make amends for an unlucky defeat last time. He was travelling strongly when all but brought down by the eventual winner on the home bend and flew home when regathering his balance. Though he's been raised 4lb for that he remains well treated on his hurdle form and can account for top weight Cusano who returned to form last time behind a progressive rival on his reappearance. James Owen has been in flying form with his new recruits and he's booked Sean Bowen for Mr Le Philopsophe who looks on a fair mark on his maiden form. If he's fit and ready to figre after a break he will be a big threat.

He looks well treated on his easy hurdles win on his penultimate start and is best forgiven his latest run where he failed to stay 3m. Veteran Cat Tiger hasn't looked the force of old recently but the handicapper continues to relent and although he could probably do with some rain is dangerous if allowed to dictate. Davidoc will likely be ridden the opposite way but he proved his stamina last time so if getting a decent pace to aim at he should remain competitive.
